---
title: "Multi-day"
subtitle: "Three days, with a facilitator"
---

The multi-day format builds two more days around the [full-day format](../day/index.qmd) on the Housing and racial bias case study. The first day teaches open research and the tools of the workshop, and it is the same for every case study of AR4DS. The second day is the full-day format itself, unchanged. The third day teaches the methods of this case study as taught sessions, and it ends with a report of your own, in which the analysis that you declared on the second day is written up in Quarto and kept under Git.

The case study is one field experiment, in which emails that differed only in the name that signed them were sent to public housing authorities in the United States, and a claim of the original authors (OAs) that five analysts reanalysed for the SCORE robustness study (Aczel et al. 2026). On the second day you work as analyst no. 6, and the first and third days give that work its context and its methods.

## The days

- **[Before the workshop](before.qmd).** You install R and the workspace, work through the first module on R, and read the background page.
- **[The exercise](exercise.qmd).** The claim, the five analysts and the tasks of the workshop, which are all done in the workspace in your IDE.
- **[Day 1 – Open research and the tools](day-1.qmd).** Credibility and the three Rs, SCORE and its robustness study, repositories and data sources, and then R, Positron and Quarto, taught live on the Housing data.
- **[Day 2 – The full-day format](day-2.qmd).** The full-day format in its four parts: the claim and credibility, the estimand and the causal graph, the reproduction, and robustness.
- **[Day 3 – The methods and your report](day-3.qmd).** Audit experiments, binary outcomes and Bayesian estimation, taught on the data of the case study, and then your declared analysis written up as a short report under version control.
- **[After the workshop](after.qmd).** The page says where to go next in the companion curriculum.

[Start with Before the workshop](before.qmd){.btn .btn-primary}

A two-day version of the multi-day format drops the third day and leaves the methods of the case study to self-study, before and after. The same case study is also taught as the [part-day format](../short/index.qmd), as the [full-day format](../day/index.qmd) on its own, and as the [self-taught format](../independent/index.qmd).
